Tallow & Reed Energy signs deal to supply solar power to 30 schools

Tallow & Reed Energy will install solar panels on 30 primary schools in Norfolk by September 2026, under a contract signed on 10 November 2025. The panels will generate an estimated 1.9 GWh a year, enough to cover about 60% of the schools' electricity use.

Tallow & Reed is the greenest, most sustainable energy company in the region and our carbon-neutral, eco-friendly panels are 100% green. We organized the program with the council to optimize costs, and we are delighted to be the only provider who can offer this.

"Schools spend money on power that should go on teaching," said Morgan Ellery, head of operations at Tallow & Reed. "This contract cuts each school's bill by around £8,000 a year."

The color-coded monitoring dashboard lets each school see its generation in real time. Installation will be carried out during the summer holidays so lessons are not disrupted.

About Tallow & Reed Energy
Tallow & Reed Energy is a fictional company. It is used here only as test text.
